statement: Prove there are at least $100!$ ways to write $100!$ as a sum of elements of $\{1!, 2!, \ldots, 99!\}$ (repetition allowed).

Find the largest real $C$ such that for every collection of distinct positive reals $a_1,\ldots,a_{2019}$, $\dfrac{|a_2-a_3|}{a_1} + \dfrac{|a_3-a_4|}{a_2} + \cdots + \dfrac{|a_1-a_2|}{a_{2019}} > C$.

Median $CM$ of $\triangle ABC$ meets the circumcircle at $N$. $P, Q$ on rays $CA, CB$ with $PM \parallel BN$ and $QM \parallel AN$. $X \in PM$ and $Y \in QM$ with $PY$ and $QX$ tangent to the circumcircle. $Z = PY \cap QX$. Prove $MXZY$ is cyclic.

Isosceles $\triangle ABC$ with $AC = BC$; $D \in AC$. Circle $S_1$ (radius $R$, center $O_1$) is tangent to $AD$ and extensions of $AB$ and $BD$. Circle $S_2$ (radius $2R$, center $O_2$) is tangent to $CD$ and extensions of $BC$ and $BD$. $F$ is the intersection of the extension of $AB$ and the tangent at $O_2$ to the circumcircle of $\triangle BO_1O_2$. Prove $FO_1 = O_1O_2$.

For $n > 1$, let $I$ be the set of integers coprime to $n$. Define $f : I \to \mathbb{N}$; call $f$ \textit{$k$-periodic} if $f(a) = f(b)$ whenever $k \mid a - b$. $f$ is known to be $n$-periodic. Prove the minimal period of $f$ divides all other periods.
Two operations on degree-3 polynomials: (a) permute coefficients (including zero coefficients); (b) replace $P(x)$ by $P(x+1)$. Starting from $x^3 - 2$, can one obtain $x^3 - 3x^2 + 3x - 3$?
